#   ConfigServer Threat Database › HTTP › 1 Day
#   Hypertext Transfer Protocol
#   
#   These blocklists are maintained directly by ConfigServer and are
#   compiled from connection attempts against our HTTP honeypots, as
#   well as unauthorized requests targeting web services we operate.
#   
#   The threat feeds capture malicious HTTP activity across exposed
#   internet-facing web infrastructure, including automated bots and
#   scanning tools.
#   
#   IP addresses included in this dataset have been observed performing
#   actions such as vulnerability scanning, exploitation attempts,
#   brute force attacks against web endpoints, and automated probing
#   of HTTP services.
#   
#   Blocklists prefixed with `_1d` represent activity observed within
#   the most recent 24-hour period and reflect confirmed HTTP request
#   attempts during that window, treated as high-confidence indicators
#   of malicious behavior.
#   
#   Blocklists prefixed with `_365d` are cumulative datasets covering
#   a one-year period and may include a higher rate of false positives
#   due to IP reuse, NAT, and infrastructure changes across providers.
